svg.title: share architecture and Discord link-preview flow
svg.desc: SvelteKit clients connect over HTTPS and WebSockets to a Cloudflare Worker. GitHub OAuth establishes an HMAC session. Workers Static Assets provides the SPA shell, scripts, images, and fonts. Each user has one SQLite Durable Object for text, metadata, share tokens, access budgets, and hibernating WebSocket broadcasts. R2 stores file bytes and supports multipart uploads, range reads, and streaming ZIP downloads. HTMLRewriter injects initial item data into the homepage. For Discord public-share previews, the Worker validates the token through the owner's Durable Object and renders localized Svelte HTML with Open Graph metadata. A second request for an unprotected file share's OG image revalidates the share and renders live file metadata to a 1200 by 630 PNG with resvg WASM and bundled fonts. Text and password-protected shares use the static brand image; protected metadata stays hidden. Discord requests to the homepage receive the public shell without login or private bootstrap data. Preview requests consume no access budget. Invalid, revoked, or exhausted shares return 404.
